description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the AttendanceConfigurationAPI in the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. It tests methods like getOne and update, sets up test data and mocks, and checks API behavior.

classes.name: AttendanceConfigurationAPITest
classes.description: Test class for the AttendanceConfigurationAPI, focusing on API method behaviors and data setup.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single attendance configuration using mock data and verifies API response.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an attendance configuration, including data setup and mock services.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method is not implemented and raises the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that getValidationRuleForDelete is not implemented and raises an exception.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the getOne test.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the update test.
